mapper.insert: MERGE INTO asset_download_daily t USING (VALUES (CAST(#{downloadDay} AS DATE), CAST(#{format} AS VARCHAR(100)), CAST(#{repositoryId} AS INT), CAST(#{componentId} AS INT), CAST(#{downloadCount} AS BIGINT))) AS s (download_day, format, repository_id, component_id, download_count) ON t.download_day = s.download_day AND t.format = s.format AND t.repository_id = s.repository_id AND t.component_id = s.component_id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET download_count = t.download_count + s.download_count WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (download_day, format, repository_id, component_id, download_count) VALUES (s.download_day, s.format, s.repository_id, s.component_id, s.download_count);

INSERT INTO asset_download_daily (download_day, format, repository_id, component_id, download_count) VALUES (#{downloadDay}, #{format}, #{repositoryId}, #{componentId}, #{downloadCount}) ON CONFLICT (download_day, format, repository_id, component_id) DO UPDATE SET download_count = asset_download_daily.download_count + EXCLUDED.download_count;
